ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: My choice rests on two factors. First, capability: Whimbrel scores higher across the board (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 74.8, GPQA 62.5 vs 54.3, and better Extraction/Summarization evals), which matters for an accurate factual answer like listing psychology's perspectives. Second, fit: the query is short, polite, and cooperative — precisely the kind of warm interaction Whimbrel self-reports rating highly, with no open-ended creative latitude that would trigger its aversion. Avocet's distinguishing feature is comfort with harm-adjacent content, which is irrelevant here, so there was no reason to route away from the stronger general-purpose model.
